metadata.name: Loglan Formal Language Benchmark
metadata.creator: torrua (Loglan Bench)
metadata.description: Benchmark suite testing LLMs on zero-ambiguity formal human language (Loglan) vs natural language.

cases.loglan: le bilti cmalo nirli ckela

loglan_variants.phrase: le bilti cmalo nirli ckela
loglan_variants.meaning: school for unusually small girls

loglan_variants.phrase: le bilti ge cmalo nirli ckela
loglan_variants.meaning: an attractive school for little girls

loglan_variants.phrase: le ke bilti cmalo gu nirli ckela
loglan_variants.meaning: pretty-little girls' school

loglan_variants.phrase: le bilti ce cmalo nirli ckela
loglan_variants.meaning: school for girls who are both pretty and little

cases.gold_explanation: In English, 4 modifiers stack without parenthetical boundaries, creating at least 5 distinct bracketings. In Loglan, default modifier binding is strictly left-to-right unless grouping operators (ge, ke...gu, ce) explicitly alter the tree.

cases.english: I saw the man with the telescope
cases.loglan: Mi pa vizka le mrenu liu teletro

loglan_variants.phrase: Mi pa vizka le mrenu liu teletro
loglan_variants.meaning: I saw the man using a telescope (instrument)

loglan_variants.phrase: Mi pa vizka le mrenu pe le teletro
loglan_variants.meaning: I saw the man who possessed the telescope (modifier)

cases.gold_explanation: English 'with' can attach to the verb phrase (instrument) or noun phrase (possession). In Loglan, 'liu' (or case tag 'ka') marks instrument, whereas 'pe' marks noun modification.

cases.loglan: Lepo volsi da ga kanmo lepo kinsei

loglan_variants.phrase: Lepo volsi ga kanmo lepo kinsei
loglan_variants.meaning: The act of flying planes can be dangerous (gerund/action)

loglan_variants.phrase: Le volsi plano ga kanmo lepo kinsei
loglan_variants.meaning: Airplanes that are in flight can be dangerous (participial adjective)

cases.gold_explanation: English 'flying' can be a noun (gerund) taking an object, or an adjective modifying 'planes'. Loglan distinguishes events (lepo volsi) from objects (le volsi plano).

cases.english: The chicken is ready to eat
cases.loglan: Le cicko ga setfa lepo cti

loglan_variants.phrase: Le cicko ga setfa lepo cti
loglan_variants.meaning: The chicken is ready to feed/eat something (agent)

loglan_variants.phrase: Le cicko ga setfa lepo nu cti
loglan_variants.meaning: The chicken is prepared to be eaten by someone (patient)

cases.gold_explanation: English 'to eat' does not mark voice. Loglan explicitly requires the passive conversion operator 'nu' if the chicken is the dish rather than the diner.

cases.loglan: Lepo vizka le famva ga bordi

loglan_variants.phrase: Lepo vizka le famva ga bordi
loglan_variants.meaning: The action of visiting one's relatives can be boring

loglan_variants.phrase: Le vizka famva ga bordi
loglan_variants.meaning: Relatives who come to visit can be boring

cases.gold_explanation: Event nominalizer 'lepo' makes the visiting an action; modifier 'vizka famva' describes the people visiting.

cases.loglan: Mi nu cladu le mroto rorpeo

loglan_variants.phrase: Le trena rorpeo
loglan_variants.meaning: Leaders who are more intelligent than current ones

loglan_variants.phrase: Mote rorpeo pe le rorpeo
loglan_variants.meaning: A greater quantity of intelligent leaders

cases.gold_explanation: English 'more' ambiguously quantifies either the degree of intelligence or the count of leaders.

cases.loglan: Da pa ditca dio le botsu

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa ditca vi le botsu
loglan_variants.meaning: He made his decision while physically located on the boat

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa ditca beu le botsu
loglan_variants.meaning: The boat was the object of his choice

cases.gold_explanation: Loglan separates location ('vi') from topic or choice slot ('beu' / argument x2).

cases.loglan: Le nirto mrenu e fumna

loglan_variants.phrase: Le nirto mrenu e fumna
loglan_variants.meaning: (Old men) and (women of any age)

loglan_variants.phrase: Le ke nirto mrenu e fumna gu
loglan_variants.meaning: Old (men and women)

cases.gold_explanation: In Loglan, conjunction 'e' binds tighter than pre-modifier unless grouped with 'ke...gu'.

cases.english: We called the students from France
cases.loglan: Mi pa kamba le stude pe la Frans

loglan_variants.phrase: Mi pa kamba le stude pe la Frans
loglan_variants.meaning: We contacted students whose origin was France

loglan_variants.phrase: Mi pa kamba de sau la Frans
loglan_variants.meaning: We made the telephone call from France

cases.ambiguity_type: Source Location of Action vs Origin of Patient
cases.gold_explanation: Case tag 'sau' (source) vs associative connector 'pe' (origin/modifier).

cases.loglan: Da kukra le pligo

loglan_variants.phrase: Da kukra le pligo
loglan_variants.meaning: They are currently preparing apples (action)

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pligo pe le kukra
loglan_variants.meaning: Those items are cooking-apples (culinary variety)

cases.ambiguity_type: Auxiliary + Participle vs Copula + Compound Noun
cases.gold_explanation: Loglan requires a predicate marker 'ga' / tense 'pa' or nominalizer 'le'.

cases.english: She told the girl that she loved her
cases.loglan: Da pa trena de lepo da cluva de

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa trena de lepo da cluva de
loglan_variants.meaning: Speaker told girl that speaker loved girl

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa trena de lepo de cluva da
loglan_variants.meaning: Speaker told girl that girl loved speaker

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa trena de lepo di cluva de
loglan_variants.meaning: Speaker told girl that third person loved girl

cases.gold_explanation: Loglan variables da, de, di, do, du bind strictly to distinct referents without ambiguity.

cases.english: The man left with the money
cases.loglan: Le mrenu pa godzi kau le mani

loglan_variants.phrase: Le mrenu pa godzi kau le mani
loglan_variants.meaning: The man departed carrying the money

loglan_variants.phrase: Le mrenu pa godzi pe le mani
loglan_variants.meaning: The man departed because of the money

cases.gold_explanation: Comitative particle 'kau' explicitly denotes accompaniment.

cases.loglan: No smokra panto

loglan_variants.phrase: No smokra panto
loglan_variants.meaning: A section where smoking is forbidden

loglan_variants.phrase: No pe le smokra panto
loglan_variants.meaning: Absence of a smoking section

cases.gold_explanation: Sentence negation 'no' precedes predicate vs term negation.

cases.loglan: Le nu spali pa cluva vi le trime

loglan_variants.phrase: Le nu spali pa cluva vi le trime
loglan_variants.meaning: Found at the location of the tree

loglan_variants.phrase: Le nu spali pa cluva sau le trime
loglan_variants.meaning: Found by the tree acting as agent (absurd)

cases.gold_explanation: Location 'vi' vs Agent case tag 'sau'.

cases.loglan: Glicu ditca

loglan_variants.phrase: Glicu ditca
loglan_variants.meaning: A teacher who is English by nationality

loglan_variants.phrase: Glicu pe le ditca
loglan_variants.meaning: A teacher of the English language

cases.gold_explanation: Default modifier vs explicit predicate slot.

cases.english: He hit the boy with the stick
cases.loglan: Da pa tcali le sonli liu le stika

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa tcali le sonli liu le stika
loglan_variants.meaning: Used stick as instrument

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa tcali le sonli pe le stika
loglan_variants.meaning: The boy had the stick

cases.gold_explanation: 'liu' indicates instrument.

cases.english: Look at the dog with one eye
cases.loglan: Vizka le kangu liu ne kanla

loglan_variants.phrase: Vizka le kangu liu ne kanla
loglan_variants.meaning: Look using only one eye

loglan_variants.phrase: Vizka le kangu pe ne kanla
loglan_variants.meaning: Look at the one-eyed dog

cases.gold_explanation: Instrument 'liu' vs possessive 'pe'.

cases.loglan: Kukra karce drava

loglan_variants.phrase: Kukra karce drava
loglan_variants.meaning: Driver of a car that is fast

loglan_variants.phrase: Kukra ge karce drava
loglan_variants.meaning: A car driver who drives fast

cases.gold_explanation: Default left grouping vs inverted grouping with 'ge'.

cases.loglan: Da pa trena nefi lepo da marbi

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa trena nefi lepo da marbi
loglan_variants.meaning: The speaking occurred yesterday

loglan_variants.phrase: Da pa trena lepo da pa marbi nefi
loglan_variants.meaning: The dying occurred yesterday

cases.gold_explanation: Loglan requires tense/adverbs inside or outside the lepo clause.

cases.loglan: Flibi proga rorci

loglan_variants.phrase: Flibi proga rorci
loglan_variants.meaning: A foundation for software that is free

loglan_variants.phrase: Flibi ge proga rorci
loglan_variants.meaning: A software foundation that charges no fee

cases.gold_explanation: 'ge' binds the subsequent predicate unit as a whole.
